title: Water Cycle and Photosynthesis Unit Test
subject: science
unitTitle: Water in nature and plant processes

items.prompt: State the process by which liquid water changes into water vapour at the surface of a pond.

points.text: Notes it happens at the surface and needs heat from the surroundings

items.prompt: A cold mirror held above a kettle of boiling water becomes covered in droplets. Explain how the droplets form.

points.text: States water vapour from the kettle touches the cold mirror
States the vapour loses heat and condenses into liquid droplets

items.prompt: State two things a green plant needs from its surroundings to make food.

points.text: Names carbon dioxide from the air or water from the soil

items.prompt: Explain why a plant kept in a dark cupboard for two weeks stops growing.

points.text: States the plant receives no light in the cupboard
Links no light to no photosynthesis, so no food is made for growth

levels.label: Secure
levels.descriptor: Answers use the correct process names and link each observation to a cause.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Process names are mostly correct but the cause link is incomplete.

levels.label: Beginning
levels.descriptor: Process names are missing or confused and no cause is given.
